notes.title: Content Update #3
notes.content:
Sampo
Sampo is a ranged artillery unit, capable of taking down enemies from afar with his rockets and shoot over the walls. His ranged skills come with trade-off though, as he cannot attack in the melee range.

Desert Courtyard
This update bring a new desert themed battlefield! Fight for the control of 5 totems in this fast-paced battlefield.

Healing Bond
The update also contains one more spell called the Healing Bond, allowing you to heal both your minions and Shaman with just one spell.

notes.title: Content Update #2
notes.content:
New challengers enter the battlefield!
Varpu & Elder Varpu

The herbalist Varpu is an adept healer suitable for empowering friendly minions with some extra health. She might not be the most physically fit character, but her Herbal Wisdom buff can make your minions much stronger and Elder Varpu can heal them with Remedy every turn if necessary.

New Spells
The update also contains more new spells:
Cursed Heart
Arcane’s Call
One with the Nature
Proper Beatdown
Beast Within

Balance
We have made some improvements to the game balance and addressing two of the less valuable cards:
Reduced cost of Back from the Grave
Reduced cost of Last Stand
Reduced the effect of Infuse Mana from 3 to 2

notes.title: Free Content Update #1 Out Now!
notes.content:
Here is a brief overview of what's included in our first content update. We still have more planned and next week I will share more of the features and content you can expect to see.

AI Decks
We have added some variety into the AI Opponent behaviour and deck as the first feature update to the Single-Player mode. You can choose your opponent from preconfigured decks and find fun in challenging some of the more outlandish decks, like facing an opponent with a massive collection of Matti minions. We will also keep adding more of these decks in the future, along some other new Single-Player content.

Action Camera
You can also find a new toggleable feature called the Action Camera. With Action Camera you can easily view the opponent’s moves when it’s not your turn with an automatic camera that follows the opponent. You can find it under the gameplay section of the settings.

New Spells
We have been working hard to create that much requested additional content for the game and this first content update adds a few new spells to the game. 
Grave Robber
Neutralize
Soul Collector
Infuse Mana
Back from the Grave
Battlecry

Improvements
Improvements to Matchmaking UI

Fixes
Fixes to game stability
Fixes to deck icon handling (reverts deck icon to default for existing decks)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.11.3864
notes.content:
Hi all!

Here are the patch notes for the first patch with some fixes and small improvement. We are already working on new content and features for the game alongside fixing any remaining issues.

Improvements

Improvements to Matchmaking
Improved hover effect in Deck Icons
Various improvements to AI logic
Increased base XP amount in Single-Player matches

Fixes

Removed “Session Expired” after an opponent had joined the game
Fix for Mulligan-phase not triggering
Fixed Deckbuilder Tooltip being cut-off
Fixed UI Sound Setting not being saved properly
Fixed Elder Tooltips being incorrect at times
Fixed a crash in-game turn change
Fix for a in-game match getting stuck in action queue
Fixed an issue where minion death effect was not working properly
